item.title: The story of the dredger and the community
item.description: At the heart of this plan stood a behemoth cutter suction dredger – an engineering marvel chosen after careful studies, said to be efficient and environmentally sound.

item.title: DAR delivers P879K in livelihood projects to farmers in 2 Leyte towns
item.description: DAR Leyte Provincial Office delivered a combined P879,410.00 in livelihood interventions to two agrarian reform beneficiaries organizations (ARBOs) in the fifth district on February 12 and 13 this year.

item.title: NMP joins IMO, global maritime leaders in championing future-ready seafarers
item.description: The event convened regulators, training institutions, and industry stakeholders to address emerging challenges and reforms in maritime education and training.

item.title: Woman dead, brother injured in Northern Samar shooting; Suspect an Army member
item.description: A woman was killed and her brother wounded in a shooting incident that occurred around 9:00 AM of March 2 in Barangay Dalakit, Catarman, Northern Samar.

item.title: PLDT and Smart launch first joint store in Tacloban City
item.description: Designed as a one-stop hub for both home and mobile services, the store simplifies customer transactions by integrating processes such as Fiber applications, mobile service needs, and technical support.

item.title: 8ID crushes insurgency in Silvino Lobos, 1 CNT killed
item.description: The 8th Infantry (Stormtroopers) Division dealt a significant blow against the elements of Sub-Regional Committee (SRC) Emporium of the Eastern Visayas Regional Party Committee (EVRPC) after an armed encounter in the hinterlands of Barangay Gusaran, Silvino Lobos, Northern Samar.

item.title: Mary the surest way to Jesus
item.description: If we would just have a bit of common sense, we would know that it is always wise to go to Mary in order to get to Christ.

item.title: Stormtroopers recover firearms in consecutive Northern Samar clashes
item.description: The operations are part of ongoing efforts to locate CNT members who escaped after the November 29 clash in Barangay Nipa, Palapag.

item.title: CARD Bank opens 2nd Islamic banking branch in Marawi City
item.description: CARD Bank officially opened its second Islamic banking branch in Marawi City, Lanao del Sur, on November 24, 2025.

item.title: From screen to spotlight: Southeast Asian community filmmakers shine at the 2025 SineMaya Community Short Film Festival
item.description: The 2025 SineMaya Community Film Festival, organized by BENTE Productions, the multimedia arm of CARD MRI, culminated in an awarding ceremony on December 15, 2025, at SM City San Pablo.

item.title: 8ID neutralizes 2 CNTs, seizes firearms in an armed encounter in Las Navas, N. Samar
item.description: Troops of the 8th Infantry (Stormtroopers) Division neutralized two armed Communist-NPA-Terrorists (CNTs) and seized three high-powered firearms in a decisive encounter in the hinterlands of Barangay Bulao, Las Navas, Northern Samar.

item.title: CARD-PCPD Medical Center opens BestHealth Clinic; Offers loanable healthcare services for CARD clients
item.description: CARD-PCPD Medical Center Inc. officially opened the BestHealth Clinics and Diagnostic Center on December 1, 2025, in Brgy. San Antonio 1, San Pablo City, Laguna.

item.title: 8ID sends off 74th Infantry Battalion after successful mission
item.description: The 8th Infantry (Stormtroopers) Division conducted a send-off ceremony on 23 December 2025 to formally recognize and honor the 74th Infantry (Unbeatable) Battalion for its valuable contributions in the campaign against the Eastern Visayas Regional Party Committee (EVRPC).

item.title: Media practitioners recognized at the CARD MRI Panaghiusa Media Awards
item.description: On December 10, 2025, the CARD MRI Panaghiusa Media Awards ceremony was held at Casita Uno, Carmelite Road, Brgy, San Lucas 1, San Pablo City, Laguna.

item.title: DAR E. Visayas distributes 2K more land titles before 2025 ends
item.description: The Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) in Eastern Visayas closed the year 2025 by distributing 2,298 more land titles over the weekend.
